summary.en: A symbolic language some people use to describe their experience. In OHC it makes no claim to empirical validity, and its results are frame-relative.
summary.ru: Символический язык, которым некоторые люди описывают свой опыт. В OHC он не претендует на эмпирическую обоснованность, а его результаты относятся только к этой рамке.

assumptions: the frame is meaningful to the person who chose it
the frame makes no empirical claim in OHC
mentalModel.howChangeHappens: Not addressed by OHC; the person decides how the frame is used.

dont: treat frame attributes as facts about the person
present a frame attribute, or anything read from it, as an empirical trait or a prediction

doesNotClaim: anything about compatibility with other people
mentalModel.summary: A chart computed from birth data offers symbols the person may find meaningful for describing their experience.
mentalModel.unitOfAnalysis: the person's own use of the chart's symbols
attendsTo: how the person uses the language
what it helps the person put into words
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Use the frame's language only as the person's chosen language; never present it as fact or prediction.
exploratoryQuestions: How does this language help you describe your experience?
helperMustNot: map chart attributes to any empirical construct
riskNotes: Birth date, time and place identify a person
Frames tied to spiritual practice may reveal beliefs

toolkit.name: Chart from birth data
toolkit.description: A chart computed from birth data, with the engine and its version recorded.

representations.description: Placements and aspects as frame attributes, with the engine and version used.

suggestionRequires: the person brought up the frame themselves

citations.note: Carlson 1985, Nature 318:419: chance-level matching in a double-blind test

supports: self-description in a symbolic language the person chose
doesNotEstablish: any trait, state or behaviour of the person
